title.zh: Reddit Stock Plunges 30% as Google's AI Search Hits Traffic and User Growth
title.en: Reddit Stock Plunges 30% as Google's AI Search Hits Traffic and User Growth

current_state.zh: Reddit shares plunged 30% after the company warned that Google AI search referrals fell by over one million per week and issued weaker-than-expected Q4 revenue guidance, highlighting AI search's toll on platform traffic.
current_state.en: Reddit shares plunged 30% after the company warned that Google AI search referrals fell by over one million per week and issued weaker-than-expected Q4 revenue guidance, highlighting AI search's toll on platform traffic.
